title: Austin Council Kicks Off, Then Recesses
summary:
*   **Council Convened:** The Austin City Council officially began its regular session on August 10, 1911, led by Mayor Wooldridge.
*   **Attendance Taken:** A roll call confirmed the presence of the Mayor and three councilmen, with one member noted as absent.
*   **Prompt Recess Declared:** In an immediate procedural decision, the council voted to recess until 3:00 PM the same day, postponing further proceedings.
transcript:
Regular meeting of the City Council: Austin, Texas, August 10, 1911.
The council was called to order by the Mayor: Roll called: Present Mayor Wooldridge,
Councilman Batholomew, Lockridge Bartholomew & Powell Absent Councilman Hart On motion the
Council recessed until 3 o'clock PM this day.
